subject: Learning Methods
title: Mental Contrasting: WOOP Method
description: A quick win: understand Mental Contrasting: WOOP Method.

hook.text: Positive fantasies about success actually reduce motivation. Your brain feels the reward before you earn it and relaxes.

buildup.text: Oettingen's WOOP method: Wish, Outcome, Obstacle, Plan. You imagine the goal, then immediately imagine the obstacles.

discovery.text: Mental contrasting combines optimism and realism. The wish activates desire. The obstacle activates planning.

twist.text: Pure positive thinking is harmful. It's the contrast between wish and obstacle that generates the energy to act.

climax.text: Try WOOP: name your learning wish, envision the best outcome, name your main obstacle, then write your if-then plan.

punchline.text: Dream, then plan for the obstacle. Contrast creates action.

quiz.question: Why does pure positive thinking reduce motivation?
options: It makes goals seem too easy to bother with
The brain feels the reward before earning it and relaxes
Positive emotions interfere with memory formation
